headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 elements. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large sizes. Represents premium, elegant farm-to-table brand.

styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-forest-green-900
styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug text-forest-green-900

body.usage: Clean, highly readable sans-serif for body text, UI elements, and product descriptions.

textures.noise: Add a very subtle SVG noise overlay or a 1% opacity grain pattern to break 'digital flatness'.

layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8 lg:gap-12
layouts_and_grids.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Section padding should be py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Prioritize optical alignment. Left-align text for readability, especially for product descriptions. Asymmetric layouts are encouraged for storytelling sections.

buttons.primary: bg-deep_forest_green text-white hover:bg-dark_green px-8 py-3 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-soft
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white hover:bg-[#1DA851] px-8 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-soft
buttons.outline: border-2 border-deep_forest_green text-deep_forest_green hover:bg-deep_forest_green hover:text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-full transition-all

cards.product_card: bg-surface rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border-light shadow-soft transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-card_hover flex flex-col h-full

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-background-primary/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border-light transition-all

motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a softer, longer shadow.
motion.scroll_animations: Use Framer Motion to reveal sections on scroll. Stagger children elements (like product cards) by 0.1s.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth 300ms transitions on colors and transforms. Ease-out-expo timing functions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against background meets at least WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.aria: Use descriptive aria-labels for icon buttons and links.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-order-button').

media.images: Use realistic, high-quality photography. No generic vector illustrations. Images should be slightly desaturated or color-graded to match the premium, earthy tone. Max height for mobile hero images: 70vh.

hero.description: Vibrant green microgreens thriving in natural sunlight

about_story.description: bokeh photography of person carrying soil (farmer hands)

gyoc_process.description: Detailed shot of seedlings growing in trays

product_general_1.description: Top-down view of thriving green microgreens

payment_qr_placeholder.description: Fallback image for QR code before admin upload (Mainly use a generic placeholder like 'Generate Payment QR' text over a solid bg if needed, or allow admin to upload directly)

iconography.style: Minimalist, stroke-based, consistent line weight (1.5px or 2px). Earthy green colors.

instructions_to_main_agent.page_structure: Build a React-Router driven multipage site or a unified scrollable site with clear routing (Home, Our Microgreens, G.Y.O.C, Ways to Enjoy, About, Contact, Payment, Admin). Update user requirement says 'multipage website' - ensure robust routing.
instructions_to_main_agent.product_data: Hardcode the exactly 14 requested varieties with their specific exact names and prices (Regular & GYOC), plus Signature Mix (Regular only).
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_integration: CTAs on product cards should link to WhatsApp (https://wa.me/919482428467) with a pre-filled message (e.g., '?text=Hello Micro Might! I would like to order [Product Name] - [Weight].').
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_dashboard: Create a simple authenticated demo login route (/admin). Inside, a minimal dashboard for replacing the 'Payment QR'. No complex backend needed if it's purely a frontend mockup/demo (use localStorage for persisting the uploaded QR image data URL across reloads in demo mode).
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Rely heavily on Tailwind for layouts. Avoid using generic Shadcn cards for the main marketing content if they look too 'SaaS-like' - customize them heavily with padding, rounded corners, and soft shadows to feel like a premium farm-to-table brand.
instructions_to_main_agent.universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure spacing is generous (use 2-3x more spacing). NEVER use AI emoji characters. Avoid centered generic layouts; tension creates interest. DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
